article.title: OpenAI unveils Lockdown Mode to protect sensitive data from prompt injection attacks
article.summary: Even with Lockdown Mode, ChatGPT could be still vulnerable to prompt injections, but the goal is to reduce the likelihood that sensitive data gets shared in the process.
